title: A prospective study to evaluate clinical, neurophysiological and neuropsychological consequences of epilepsy surgery in patients with symptomatic focal epilepsy refractory to pharmacotherapy
summary: With this prospective observational clinical study we would like to investigate how in patients with refractory epilepsy aspects like seizure frequency, neuropsychology and quality of life develop after epilepsy surgery.
conditions: Localization-related (focal)(partial) symptomatic epilepsy and epileptic syndromes with complex partial seizures

interventions.name: Patient recruitment will be based on the epilepsy outpatient clinic and the epilepsy monitoring unit of the University Medical Center Göttingen. Decisions for epilepsy surgery will be made solely on clinical grounds and independent of this study.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Medication refractory epilepsy (as of current Guidelines of the ILAE);
- Decision for resective epilepsy surgery based on an interdisciplinary case-conference
Exclusion criteria:
Idiopathic generalized epilepsy
